q: A measure-preserving system (X, μ, T) is ergodic if and only if the Koopman operator Uf = f∘T has:
opts: Only constant functions as fixed points (eigenvalue 1 has multiplicity 1)
All eigenvalues on the unit circle
exp: Ergodicity ↔ invariant functions are constant a.e. ↔ the eigenspace for eigenvalue 1 of the Koopman operator is one-dimensional (spanned by constants).
